name: dumbbell hammer curl
description: A standing curl with a dumbbell in each hand and the palms facing inward. It works the biceps, brachialis and forearms.
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides and palms facing inward.
Keep your elbows near your torso and curl the dumbbells without rotating your wrists.
Pause near shoulder height, then lower slowly without swinging.
